name: Maria-sama ga Gyakuten ~Etape de l'hiver~
original_name: マリア様が逆転～Etape de l'hiver～
source:
The continuation of Maria-sama trials brings two new episodes - one for the school festival and another one for Christmas.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瑪莉亞大人的審判再度開庭，這回有兩個新篇章：一個關於學園祭，另一個關於聖誕節。

（來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndreview[/url]）
